product_result: Search3 now has one responsive hotel-name filter for already loaded result cards. It preserves the query through sorting, reports the filtered loaded-card count and clears on a new search without calling a supplier API.

served_bytes.accounting: The filter is in an already loaded Search3 asset, so the honest raw CSS/JS increase is 1812 bytes for both initial and full route totals. No HTTP path or lazy-loading claim is added.

contracts: case and whitespace normalized hotel-name match
active query preserved and reapplied after sort rerender
new-search reset clears and hides the control
raw and served bundle DOM/geometry parity

publication.attempt_result: Both controls were closed without merge or deploy because connector-created ref/content updates emitted Security PR checks but no push event for the one-shot deployment workflow.

deferred: Publish the existing exact artifact when an authenticated push can trigger the one-shot control workflow; do not rebuild merely for documentation.
Physical Safari and owner production acceptance remain deferred.
rollback: Revert release merge fd0d0cf69b2b3928575c7c68d6afe5f62f1eab56 independently. Published preview rollback is unchanged because this package was not deployed.
next_action: Audit completeness of loaded-result rating, category, sea-distance and meal fields; expose at most one useful local facet only when every loaded card has complete data, without restoring retired filter layers or duplicating ANEX work.
